stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 first-time, first-year): 3,745 applied, 3,554 admitted, 543 enrolled; the residency table lists 39 international applicants, all 39 admitted, 9 enrolled. Out-of-state counts exclude international. SAT scores were sent by 7% (38 students) and ACT scores by 1% (6), so the SAT range rests on few students; no ACT percentiles were printed. The GPA breakdown also shows 0.2% of students below a 1.0 GPA (not in the distribution). The average high school GPA is printed as '85.7 or 3' (a 100-point figure and a truncated 4.0 value), so the average GPA is not shown. The Common Data Set does not mark the open-admission boxes. Undergraduate enrollment is 3,459 (IPEDS fall 2024) and there are 52 nonresident-alien undergraduates (IPEDS fall 2024 enrollment by race via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal).

cost.notes: College Navigator 2024-25: tuition includes required fees; total is the on-campus cost of attendance for New York residents ($32,880 at the out-of-state rate). The tuition boxes in the Common Data Set are blank in the PDF. The published international cost table is listed separately
